text:
The dentist had a terrible attitude. They tried to fill my tooth anyway, filling the neck of my wisdom tooth because it had shifted and was hitting it. They quoted 1,200 baht, saying it was definitely possible, but it might fall out frequently, and that I had a one-year warranty. They said I could come back if needed. When I went back for the third time, even though it was under warranty, they started arguing and insulting me.
Dentist: "Why would you fill it? It can't be filled; you have to cut the gum." I asked if they couldn't do it the first time I went, and they said yes, it would cost around 4,000 baht and require gum treatment. As soon as I mentioned that, the money issue came up. This time, they emphasized again that they needed to cut the gum.

Me: "I can go to a bigger hospital for treatment later, but could you please fill it for me now? I'm not going immediately."

Dentist: "Why fill it? It'll just fall out! It can't fall out!!"

Me: "It's still a long time until I can come back for the filling." "I'm afraid food particles will get in and cause decay."

Dentist: "Where are the food particles? I don't see any."
(How could they? I brushed my teeth before coming to the doctor, and I rinsed with mouthwash.)

Dentist: "Well, if you want to fill it, then fill it. If it's going to fall out, then fill it." (His tone became increasingly displeased.)

Me: "So, in short, you don't want to fill it, do you?" (I got up from the chair, shocked by the doctor's behavior.)

Dentist: "That's right!!!" (His voice grew louder) "If you fill it, it'll fall out, so what's the point of filling it?!"

Me: "Don't you have any manners? It's covered by insurance, that's why I came to get it filled. Why are you telling me to get it filled if you can't do it yourself, and you're making me pay several thousand baht more?"

This doctor, whose teeth weren't severely crooked, tried to get me braces. I said no, I've been to the dentist 2-3 times already. Finally, after I said no, he said, "Okay, but tartar will stick easily. My daughter keeps pushing it out." He seemed annoyed. I told the story to the person at the front desk who was going to reschedule my appointment, and the head of the department said the doctor had no vested interest because he wasn't an orthodontist. Yes, the doctor isn't an orthodontist, but the clinic makes money, and it affects their bonus.

After that, this elderly female doctor started yelling and arguing with us; her manners were terrible. We walked out to the front of the clinic and met someone at the counter. We told them that the doctor here had very poor manners. They then called us in to talk and offered to reschedule, but at that point, we thought, "What if she's unhappy and does a bad job?" Even though it's the Pata branch, we were worried. We saw reviews about the Pata branch and decided not to continue treatment there. It was scary; what if she's unhappy and does something to our mouth?
